title: Bakos et al. (2006): A Stellar Companion in the HD 189733 System with a Known Transiting Extrasolar Planet

evidence.locator: Abstract and sections 2.2-3: mid-M companion at a projected 216 au; radial velocities -2.38 +/- 0.20 (A) and -3.1 +/- 1.0 km/s (B); differential proper motion -1 +/- 5, -21.2 +/- 5 mas/yr; period about 3200 years if the orbit is circular and seen face on; 'it is premature to derive specific orbital parameters'
